context: A filterable Bubbles list with a spinner that must keep animating

checklist.name: keys_respect_filtering
checklist.description: Checks whether the list is editing its filter (`SettingFilter()` or `FilterState() == list.Filtering`) before acting on enter or other keys, so typing a filter and confirming it with enter still reach the list.

checklist.name: spinner_keeps_ticking
checklist.description: Starts the spinner with its `Tick` from `Init` and passes every message (not only key presses) through `spinner.Update`, storing the returned model and returning its command, so the spinner animates while the list has focus.

checklist.name: list_sized
checklist.description: Sizes the list from `tea.WindowSizeMsg` with `SetSize` (or `SetWidth` and `SetHeight`) instead of leaving it at zero.

checklist.name: models_stored_back
checklist.description: Stores the models returned by `list.Update` and `spinner.Update` back into the parent model and batches their commands.

checklist.name: result_from_selected_item
checklist.description: On enter outside filtering, reads `SelectedItem()` and prints the name after `Run` returns, not from inside `Update`.
